text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri meets EU Commissioner on Immigration Anita Gradin and calls on Europe to help in eradicating cannabis plantations in northern Morocco.
- Morocco releases 66 Polisario Front prisoners for humanitarian reasons.
- European fleet resumes fishing in Moroccan waters after end of resting period for fish stocks.
- Unemployment rate fell to 19.4 percent of the workforce in the first quarter of 1996, from 22.9 percent in the last quarter of 1995.
- France's Agriculture Minister Philippe Vasseur on a four-day visit to Morocco.
- Moroccan exports of citrus and vegetables, avoided by EU countries but saved by Eastern Europe markets.

- French writer Roger Garaudy says: "By opposing my visit to Morocco, Israel intruded in its internal affairs." Morocco prevented Garaudy from speaking on his latest book "The Founder Myths of Israel".
